    The sky

    Short gives a few lines per card and a one paragraph answer. Weave it in adds an “Under this sky” section reading the moon, sun sign, planetary day and hour against the cards.

    Your reading

    Card of the day

    One card each morning. Pull it from your deck, tell me what it was, and carry its note through the day. Over time you will see which cards keep finding you.

    The Deck

    All seventy eight cards of the Rider Waite Smith deck, drawn by Pamela Colman Smith in 1909. Open any card for its upright and reversed meanings and correspondences.

    Journal

    Readings you have saved, with their cards, the reading and your notes. Open one to lay it on the table again.

    Card images: Rider Waite Smith deck, 1909, public domain. Meanings, dignities, pairings and written readings are one reader’s approach: trust your own.
